projects.name: Shake Your Power CIC
projects.text: SPARK, the first energy-generating musical instrument. Granted a US patent and two London Design Award Golds (SPARK in 2014, DIY SPARK in 2015). STEM pilots in the UK, the US and India, with UCL Academy and Pratham; manufactured in Shenzhen.

projects.name: Monogram Publishers
projects.text: Independent publishing house. Publisher of The Art of Getting Stuff Done (2022).

projects.name: Glass Lab / Trash Surface Bureau
projects.text: Recycled-glass surface products made from the commercial waste of London businesses. Featured in FRAME Magazine, Inhabitat and Designer Pages.

projects.name: Fictional Objects
projects.text: Speculative objects for futures that do not exist yet (the Human Behaviour Control Machine, the Lightning Harvester, the Prayer Transmitter, the Dream Time Machine), made alongside the MA dissertation on myth and design.
